verdict.rationale: The docs show that Computer accepts delegated multi-step tasks and keeps working on them autonomously after the call returns. The client can reconnect via thread_id and receives progress notifications. There is no evidence of setting up automations as recurring schedules or triggers; the evidence shows only one-off background tasks, and calendar-event scheduling is a different feature. missing for 10: recurring/scheduled or event-triggered automation setup, documentation of unattended background runs without an active client, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: your MCP client can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.
The task may still be running. Keep the `thread_id` and call `call_perplexity_computer` again with that same `thread_id`
The Computer MCP server sends status updates as MCP progress notifications while a task runs.
